title: "MATH 320: APplied Probability and Statistics"

This website provides interactive note outlines, assinments, and other resources for MATH 320: Applied Probability and Statistics at California State University, Monterey Bay.  It uses the following packages:  

1. `ggformula`  
2. `mosaic`  
3. `tidyverse`  
5. `stats`
